scoring_justification: The headline energies are produced by a full Buckingham potential calculation; recomputing them in the verifier sandbox is infeasible. Therefore we compare the agent's submitted results.json against the paper-reported values with an absolute tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference energies for IAM components and IEM
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper; for Ir6(CO)16 black per-molecule C–C rep assigned as half of the total C–C (2.63) to each of the two independent molecules; C–C attr set to 0 because the paper did not partition C–C.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Taken directly from the paper's published table, with a reasonable split of the total C–C between independent molecules.

required.Mn2(CO)10_rt: object with keys IAM_O_O, IAM_O_C, IAM_C_C_rep, IAM_C_C_attr, IAM_M_O, IEM (all numbers in kcal/mol)
required.Ir6(CO)16_black: object with key 'molecules' (array of objects, each with keys IAM_O_O, IAM_O_C, IAM_C_C_rep, IAM_C_C_attr, IEM)
required.Ir6(CO)16_red: object with keys IAM_O_O, IAM_O_C, IAM_C_C, IEM

outputs.description: Reproduced intramolecular energy components (partitioned) and total intermolecular energy for the three target clusters. Compared to paper-reported reference values with absolute tolerance, and structural trend checks (IEM black < IEM red; total IAM red < total IAM black).

output_contract.notes: The output file must be valid JSON. For Ir6(CO)16_black the molecules array must contain exactly two elements corresponding to the two independent molecules in the crystal. For Ir6(CO)16_red the key IAM_C_C is the total C-C intramolecular energy (not split into repulsive/attractive). All values are floating-point numbers in kcal/mol.

steps.description: Compare every numeric field in results.json against the paper-derived gold values with absolute tolerance 0.5 kcal/mol.
Check that intermolecular packing favours the black isomer: total IEM(black) < IEM(red).
Check that intramolecular energy favours the red isomer: total IAM(red) < average IAM(black) (per molecule).
